name: reinstall
summary: ask for the node a claim runs to be wiped and installed again on the same machine (the operator proposes it)
description:
reinstall wipes and installs the same node on the same machine again: for a
corrupted install, or after a disk was replaced (edit the TalosNode's
installDiskSelector first). The operation drains the node, takes a control
plane out of etcd, resets the system disk, boots the installer and waits for
the node to check in again. Approve it with pk-metal approve.

A control plane of a three-member cluster is down to two members while it
reinstalls, an even count the operator refuses without --ack-etcd-risk.

flags.name: ack-etcd-risk
flags.usage: reason to accept an even or short etcd membership while a control plane reinstalls; stored on the claim as "<your username>: <reason>"

flags.name: context
flags.usage: kubeconfig context to use (default: the current context)

flags.name: kubeconfig
flags.usage: kubeconfig file (default: $KUBECONFIG, then ~/.kube/config, then the in-cluster account)
